definitions.gloss: Shinto priest; Shinto clergy; shrine priest
definitions.explanation: A person who serves at a Shinto shrine and performs religious ceremonies, rituals, and other duties. The general term for all ranks of Shinto priesthood.

examples.japanese: {神職|しんしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{祝詞|のりと}→祝詞：30669_norito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奏上|そうじょう}→奏上：30670_soujou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Shinto priest recited the ritual prayer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{神職|しんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めている→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: He serves as a Shinto priest at the local shrine.

examples.japanese: {神職|しんしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{神道|しんとう}→神道：09586_shintou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: To become a Shinto priest, it is common to study Shinto at university.

notes:
A compound of {神|しん} (god, divine) + ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧ (occupation, profession). The general term for Shinto religious professionals at any rank.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神職|しんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as a Shinto priest
- {神職|しんしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to take up the Shinto priesthood
- {神職|しんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: qualification as a Shinto priest

SHINTO PRIESTHOOD RANKS:
- ⟦{宮司|ぐうじ}→宮司：12654_guuji⟧: chief priest — the head priest of a shrine
- ⟦{禰宜|ねぎ}→禰宜：24980_negi⟧: senior priest — second in rank
- {権禰宜|ごんねぎ}: associate priest — a junior priest
- ⟦{巫女|みこ}→巫女：12408_miko⟧: shrine maiden — a young woman who assists with shrine duties (not technically a {神職|しんしょく})

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{僧侶|そうりょ}→僧侶：11529_souryo⟧: Buddhist monk/priest — the equivalent for Buddhism
- ⟦{宮司|ぐうじ}→宮司：12654_guuji⟧: chief priest — specifically the head of a shrine
- ⟦{神主|かんぬし}→神主：16732_kannushi⟧: shrine priest — a more colloquial term, often used interchangeably with {神職|しんしょく}
